rehearsal: the cheapest model reads a ticket cold three times and tries to build it on paper, so "buildable as written" is measured. → CodeMother Its point is "what questions does the plan not answer". So it is handed the plan steps, the frame (intention, why, falsifier), and what exists and what does not, measured before the read; each step answers builds or stopped, with what is missing. "Cold" means no conversation, history, chart or process, not blind to the disk. (Akien 2026-10-29, open-692f24d32b18.)
